messages:
dana: Quick sync — saw steady RSS + heap-like growth on KV serving nodes for a handful of long-ctx tenants over the last 48h. pprof shows hot "page_walk" and "alloc_slab" paths. Anyone else?

omar: yup, saw alerts. growth correlates with longctx token counts and repeated new prefixes from same tenant. Feels like low reuse and fragmentation.

li: I ran a short repro on staging. Lots of small page allocations (4k pages) and a slow path in kernel pagewalk when slab churn spikes. Stacktrace pasted below.

miko: can you drop the pprof flamegraph? curious.

li: ```
$ go tool pprof -http=:8080 ./kvprof
(pprof) top
100ms  40.0% 40.0% runtime.pageWalk
60ms   24.0% 64.0% runtime.allocSlab
40ms   16.0% 80.0% kv.CacheEvict
```

pranay: hypothesis: our per-tenant residency accounting only considers full pages, not subpage fragmentation; noisy tenant with many small contexts drives fragmentation and prevents reuse.

dana: suggestion: try "lease sampling" — attach short-lived soft leases for pages with access counters; periodically sample which leases are live and allow compaction if a page's live-leases drop below threshold.

omar: also, kernel selection matters: on A100 kernels for matmul we scheduled concurrently causing CPU-side pagewalk spikes; switching to a different kernel batch decreased pagewalk syscalls and reduced the p99 tail.

miko: we tried per-tenant soft quotas in canary — allowed eviction rate to target 2% instead of absolute pages. cut steady growth by ~30% but increased latency P95 for cold requests (tradeoff).

li: logs from staging: "evict_attempt=1 tenant=acme-42 pages=12 reuse=3 fragmentation=0.65"

dana: Proposal: run randomized lease sampling + eviction smoothing + batch-friendly kernel scheduling. Plan: run 6h A/B on a rack. Who owns rollout?

omar: I'll own infra changes. Need config params: sample_interval, lease_ttl, eviction_smoothing_window.

pranay: default values I'd test: sample_interval=30s, lease_ttl=90s, smoothing_window=5m. Also add metric "tenant_fragmentation" gauge (fragmented_pages / total_pages).

miko: add synthetic test in perf harness that creates many small prefixes to validate fragmentation and reuse under load.

devbot: deploy bot: canary started for rack-7 with config revision rkd-2026-03-18-lease-sample

li: quick note — watch for interactions with KV cache prefetch; sampling may prevent prefetch heuristics from warming expected pages which could worsen cold latency.

dana: agreed. Also add a pact test to ensure no large regression on token throughput for default workloads.

omar: timeline: infra rollout today, perf harness tomorrow, analysis EOD.

miko: +1. ping me if we need to tweak smoothing.

pranay: I'll dashboard to show per-tenant residency, evict_rate, fragment_ratio and ship alerts if fragment_ratio > 0.6 for >10m.

dana: thanks team. will circle back with results and the first 6h A/B report.
